invite.title: Accept invitation
invite.subtitle: Choose a password to activate your account.
invite.invalidTitle: This invitation link is invalid or has expired
invite.invalidBody: Ask your company administrator to send a new invitation.
invite.passwordRejectedBody: The password was not accepted. Choose another one that meets the rules and try again.
invite.inProgressBody: Wait a moment, then try again.

accountLink.mobileHint: Enter it in international form, or start with 05 and we add +966.
accountLink.invalidTitle: The link is invalid or has expired
accountLink.invalidBody: Ask your company administrator for a new link, or use "Forgot password?" on the sign-in page.
accountLink.unavailableTitle: The service is unavailable right now
accountLink.unavailableBody: Try again in a moment. What you typed is still on the page.
accountLink.passwordRejectedBody: Choose a password of at least 12 characters and try again.
accountLink.mobileInvalid: Enter a valid international mobile number, such as +966500000001.
accountLink.mobileTaken: This mobile number belongs to another account.

join.invalidTitle: The invitation has expired or was already used
join.invalidBody: Ask your company administrator to send it again.
join.title: Accept invitation
join.subtitle: Enter your mobile number and choose your password to activate your account.
join.successBody: Sign in with the password you chose.

forgot.title: Forgot password?
forgot.subtitle: Enter your email and we send you a link to reset your password.
forgot.sentBody: If this email has an active account, a reset link arrives within minutes. The link works once and for 60 minutes.

reset.title: New password
reset.subtitle: Choose a new password for your account.
reset.successBody: Sign in with the new password. Your other sessions were ended.

mobileStep.title: Add your mobile number
mobileStep.subtitle: Every account needs a mobile number. Your colleagues cannot see it; only user administrators can.
mobileStep.signOutFailed: Could not end the session. Try again.
